meta.name: Hostel Days
meta.description: Set in an engineering college hostel, this series follows the life of Six engineering students and their struggles with friendship, identity, love, life and academics.

videos.title: Room no. 209
videos.overview: There’s a confusion in the room allocation as Sai joins the hostel late. But can this confusion create room for friendship?

videos.title: Rakshakudu
videos.overview: Sai grapples with his identity crisis as the others struggle to get into various clubs. Who will “save” Sai?

videos.title: First Love
videos.overview: Sai experiences the pangs of first love as Kavya texts him. First love is like magic. But is it real?

videos.title: GRP
videos.overview: Sai hides his birthday from his friends to avoid GRP and spend time with Kavya. Will he succeed in either?

videos.title: M1 Exam
videos.overview: The most dreaded exam - M1 turns out to be a test of character and friendship for all the six students.
